slice: R.241 Dashboard Production Summary Query Path Optimization
phase: Phase 3 Admin Read Model and Query API performance
full_goal_statement: This advances Admin Architecture v1 by reducing a Dashboard background query cost at the read-model boundary. It does not complete Protection Gate coverage, route-loader restructuring, page information architecture, redundancy cleanup, Docker release gates, or the full Admin Architecture v1 goal.

role_review.project_architect: approved: the slice keeps Dashboard metrics on the read-model/query mainline and removes page-time SQLite table counting rather than adding UI loading polish.
role_review.delivery_lead: approved: the change is GET/read-path only, preserves response shape and metadata snapshot gates, and is accepted with focused tests, typecheck, read-only NAS performance evidence, and governance audit.

summary: readAdminDashboardProductionSummaryFromStore now opens admin.sqlite once and reuses metadata/counts for freshness.
The Dashboard production-summary hot path no longer runs COUNT(*) over preprocess_job_status on every background metrics miss.
The hot path still refuses missing stores, stale stores, incomplete preprocess job snapshots, and snapshot metadata row-count mismatches.
A focused regression test covers metadata row-count mismatch returning null.
non_goals: No read-model rebuild or reconcile start.
No broad cache or fixture substitution.

query_plan_findings: completed_at, indexed_at, and failed_at day-range queries use existing indexes.
The dominant avoidable cost was COUNT(*) over preprocess_job_status on the NAS SQLite store.
Metadata reads and remaining day-range index probes still cost fixed SMB/SQLite time, so material_summary and usage_metrics remain separate candidates.

verification.redundancy_audit_note: The audit command exited successfully and preserved the governance state: cleanup remains blocked until candidates are reviewed. This is expected because R.241 is not a redundancy-cleanup slice.

remaining_gaps: Dashboard material_summary still costs about 144ms on the observed NAS run.
usage_metrics still costs about 100ms on the observed NAS run.
source-video status_store_page remains the dominant source-video status-list cost.
Route-loader restructuring, UI information architecture, Protection Gate completion, redundancy cleanup, Docker release gates, and full Admin Architecture v1 remain incomplete.
